name: Chamber of Marathwada Industries and Agriculture
tagline: The voice of Marathwada industry since 1969.
_yearsActive_note: Published on the old homepage as '57 years'. Consistent with a 1969 founding. Update once a year.
description: An association of the leading industries, organisations and individuals working for industrialisation and the overall development of the Marathwada region.
positioning: An association of the leading industries, organisations and individuals working for industrialisation and the overall development of Marathwada.
Close association with national bodies — CII, FICCI and ASSOCHAM — and a record of acting as a catalyst for the region's industrial growth.
CMIA has been the initiator of many of the ideas that went on to develop the region.
